result.description:
About the Company

OnSpec DAQ Pty Ltd is an Australian company delivering intelligent and innovative engineering solutions to the Oil & Gas industry. The company specialises in wireline services, data acquisition systems, reservoir evaluation and engineering support, providing high-quality technical services through safe, efficient and innovative operational practices.

Our commitment is to deliver engineering excellence while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality and environmental responsibility across all operations.

The Role

OnSpec is seeking an experienced Petroleum Engineer – Logging Technician (Wireline Services) to join our team in Chinchilla, Queensland.

This permanent full-time role combines petroleum engineering responsibilities with specialist wireline logging operations. The successful applicant will support reservoir evaluation, drilling, well completion, production optimisation and well intervention activities while providing technical leadership during wireline field operations.

The position requires a strong understanding of petroleum engineering principles together with practical experience in wireline logging services to support clients throughout exploration and production operations.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, design and optimise well intervention and reservoir evaluation programs to maximise hydrocarbon recovery.
Analyse geological, petrophysical and reservoir data to support drilling, completion and production decisions.
Develop engineering solutions to improve well productivity and operational efficiency.
Monitor well performance and recommend remedial actions based on engineering analysis.
Design and evaluate well completion and production strategies in accordance with engineering standards.
Provide technical support during drilling, completion and intervention operations.
Assess operational risks and ensure compliance with Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) requirements.
Prepare engineering reports, technical recommendations and operational documentation.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including geologists, drilling engineers and production engineers.
Review operational results and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
Operate wireline logging equipment to obtain accurate downhole formation and well integrity data.
Conduct open-hole and cased-hole logging operations in accordance with company procedures and client specifications.
Perform equipment testing, calibration and functional checks before field operations.
Interpret logging data to support reservoir evaluation and well diagnostics.
Troubleshoot wireline equipment and resolve technical issues during field activities.
Coordinate rig-up and rig-down activities ensuring safe operational execution.
Maintain engineering documentation, operational records and service reports.
Coordinate logistics, equipment utilisation and maintenance schedules.
Prepare post-job engineering reports and communicate technical outcomes to clients.
The Ideal Candidate

Bachelor’s Degree in Petroleum Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
Demonstrated experience in petroleum engineering, reservoir evaluation and wireline logging operations.
Sound understanding of drilling, completion, production and well intervention engineering.
Experience interpreting wireline logging data and supporting reservoir characterisation.
Strong analytical and engineering problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of Australian Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) standards.
Current Australian C Class Driver Licence (essential).
Forklift Licence or willingness to obtain.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work within multidisciplinary engineering teams.
No additional registration or licensing is required.

Diversity and Inclusion

OnSpec DAQ Pty Ltd is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, women, the LGBTQIA+ community, mature-aged workers, people living with disabilities and applicants from culturally diverse backgrounds.

result.description:
Membership and Systems Manager

Permanent part-time | 15 hours per week | Hybrid | Edgecliff, Sydney

PRIMA Recruitment & Consultancy is recruiting a Membership and Systems Manager for a respected, long-established medical membership organisation based in Edgecliff.

This is a permanent part-time opportunity offering approximately 15 hours per week. The role will combine membership administration, member engagement, database and CRM management, reporting, operational coordination and support for the organisation’s systems transition.

About the role

The Membership and Systems Manager will support the effective delivery of membership services while maintaining accurate systems, records and reporting.

Key responsibilities include:

Managing membership enquiries and providing responsive member support
Maintaining accurate membership records and database information
Supporting membership applications, renewals and related administration
Producing membership reports and monitoring data quality
Coordinating member communications and engagement activities
Supporting the implementation and ongoing use of the organisation’s membership management system
Assisting with data migration, validation, reconciliation and process documentation
Liaising with internal stakeholders and external software or service providers
Identifying opportunities to improve membership and administrative processes
Providing general operational and administrative support as required
About you

You may currently work in a professional association, membership organisation, not-for-profit, medical college, education provider or another member-focused environment.

You will ideally bring:

Experience in membership services, association administration or customer service
Experience using a membership database, CRM or Association Management System
Strong data accuracy, reporting and record-management skills
Confidence communicating with members and senior stakeholders
Strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently
Experience supporting a system implementation or data migration would be highly regarded
Experience with Microsoft Upbeat CRM would be particularly advantageous

This opportunity may suit an experienced professional seeking meaningful part-time work, balancing other professional or personal commitments, building a portfolio career or returning to the workforce.

Working arrangement
Permanent part-time employment
Approximately 15 hours per week
Usually worked across two days
Hybrid working arrangement
At least one day per week in the Edgecliff office is preferred
Salary

The salary range is:

$90,000–$105,000 per annum plus superannuation on a full-time equivalent basis.

As this role is approximately 0.4 FTE, the actual pro-rated salary is approximately:

$36,000–$42,000 per annum plus superannuation.

This equates to approximately $46–$54 per hour, depending on the final salary offered.

Eligibility

Applicants must have valid Australian working rights. Candidates holding temporary visas may be considered, subject to verification of their individual visa conditions and ongoing ability to perform the required hours.
How to apply

Please apply through Workforce Australia and include an up-to-date CV outlining your relevant membership, CRM, database, reporting and stakeholder-engagement experience.

For a confidential discussion, contact:

Pri Menon Gillett
Founder and Managing Director
PRIMA Recruitment & Consultancy Pty Ltd
Email: pri@primarecruitmentandconsultancy.com.au
PRIMA welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including professionals returning to the workforce.

Identify supply chain gaps, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement through the application of continuous improvement methodologies and data-driven analysis.  Analyse and evaluate current supply chain systems, inventory management processes, logistics operations, and distribution networks to enhance performance.  Provide recommendations based on analysis of current processes to address operational challenges and improve supply chain effectiveness.  Prepare and recommend proposals to optimise procedures, streamline workflows, improve inventory controls, and support process innovation and business improvements.  Assist in implementing approved supply chain initiatives and monitor outcomes to ensure operational objectives are achieved.  Develop and maintain performance metrics, reports, and dashboards to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement.  Collaborate with procurement, logistics, warehousing, and operations teams to improve coordination and enhance overall supply chain performance.  Support supplier performance evaluations and contribute to initiatives aimed at reducing costs, mitigating risks, and improving service levels.  Provide guidance, training, and support to team members to build capabilities and promote best practices across supply chain operations.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor's degree or above  Minimum of 1 year of experience in supply chain analysis  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills  Excellent communication and presentation abilities  Proficiency in data analysis tools and software  Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies   About Company     Arcella Bananas is the marketing arm of Tropicana Bananas, a family-owned business with over 50 years of experience in the banana industry. We are dedicated to sustainably producing and delivering premium-quality bananas through an integrated approach to farming, packing, ripening, and marketing.
